events.title: New Demo Update Live!
events.summary: Howdy, Cowboys!We have some exciting news! A fresh Demo update is now live on Steam. Based on your feedback, we’ve reworked and polished several systems to deliver the best experience possible.🛠️ What’s new in this build:New Visual Style & Graphics: A refined visual identity, paired with general performance optimizations for smoother gameplay on low-end machines.New Voiceovers & Improved Localization: Added new audio lines and polished multi-language support.Controls & Accessibility: Added mouse

events.title: Demo Updated with Bug Fixes and Traditional Chinese Support
events.summary: Hello everyone!Just stopping by to let you know the demo has received a new update with small bug fixes to make the experience smoother and more stable.I’ve also added Traditional Chinese support, so even more players can explore the beginning of Rustborn’s journey.Meanwhile, I’m continuing to work on the full game to expand the content, and more updates will be coming soon.Thank you for the support and for following the project!

events.title: Demo Launch
events.summary: After around 10 months of development, I am really happy to finally release the Rustborn demo. This version introduces the game’s prologue, where you can experience the beginning of the story, test the first weapons, and face Dr. Analyzer in a decisive boss fight.The demo lasts around 20 to 30 minutes and is designed to give a first taste of the combat, pacing, and atmosphere. events.title: Demo coming soon!!
events.summary: 🚀 Hey everyone! After months in the lab (almost literally), our sci-fi action game is taking shape. You’ll step into the boots of a cowboy abducted into an alien Starship, armed with a living weapon fused to your arm. The demo is coming later this year... so in the meantime, hitting Wishlist helps us massively and lets you be the first to know when we drop updates. Thanks for riding with us 🤠🔫✨
